column3: ? Vicente (1897 Entre Rios); Diaz Arturo (1896 Mendoza); Alejandro Guillermo (1889 La Pampa)
column4: *** WITHDRAWN, SAME DAY. *** This row first read "Montevideo 1858, son of Avelino Lerena and Ambrosia Traibel". That was a CONFLATION of two men. The Uruguayan record it rested on gives the spouse as Ema Regules - and Ema Regules married JUAN ARTURO Lerena Traibel (1861-1936), whose children were born at Montevideo 1881-1887. The Arturo in this drawer married Amalia Diaz and had children in La Pampa, Mendoza and Entre Rios 1889-1897. Different man. Origin NOT established. *** AND CONFIRMED FROM A DOCUMENT, 9 October 2026: *** the Chilean death registration of his infant son at Valparaiso, 18 September 1894, writes him *** ARTURO LERENA GARCIA *** - *** so his mother was a GARCIA, not Ambrosia Traibel ***, and the withdrawal above was right. *** HIS FAMILY WAS IN CHILE: *** La Pampa 1889, VALPARAISO 1893-94, Mendoza 1896, Entre Rios 1897. *** AND PLACED ON 10 OCTOBER 2026: HE IS SPANISH. *** His son Antonio's marriage at Crespo, Entre Rios, 24 October 1924, gives '*** ARTURO LERENA, de nacionalidad ESPANOLA, de profesion PERIODISTA ***', with *** AMALIA DIAZ, PERUANA ***; and Arturo signed as a witness, *** 'de cincuenta y [units not read] anos... domiciliado en PARANA' ***, so born about 1865-1874. See data/arturo-lerena-garcia-chile.tsv.
